messages:
Sam: Tiny holiday check-in  drop a gif or one-line holiday wish and tell us if you want to join the 12pm cozy-cocoa table today! :hot_cocoa:
Ava: Wishing everyone a restful break and cookies in all sizes. Joining cocoa at noon. :cookie:
Noah: Sending digital snowflakes ❄️ Also bringing peppermint stick stash to share. :peppermint:
Priya: Count me in for cocoa and sweater contest. Who's making the prize this year? :sweater:
Sam: Prize idea: a mystery mug + a $10 coffee shop voucher. React :one: for mug, :two: for voucher, :three: both.
Ava: :three: both pls
Noah: :one: I want the mug with personality
Priya: :two: voucher for more peppermint supplies
cheer-bot: Reminder: Office holiday decor etiquette: keep walkways clear and avoid glitter on shared keyboards. :sparkles: :information_source:
Sam: Also quick kudos: shoutout to Ava for coordinating the baking sign-up. The cookie variety was excellent yesterday. :clap:
Ava: Thanks! Major baking help from Noah too  he brought the crowd-pleaser brownies. :brownie:
Noah: Brownies are happy to be famous. Also I made two trays this time because math.
Priya: Tiny poll: sweater contest categories? Ugly, handmade, and punny. React :one: ugly, :two: handmade, :three: punny, :four: all of the above.
Sam: :four: all of the above
Ava: :two: handmade ftw
Noah: :three: punny for the win
Priya: Great. We'll do all categories and one overall. Bring your sweater to the kitchen table by 12:10.
Sam: Remote folks  want to join cocoa virtually? DM me and I'll drop a tiny e-gift and send the Zoom link. :computer:
cheer-bot: Announcement: Short reminder that the office will close at 3pm on Friday for the holiday break. Please plan deliveries accordingly. :calendar:
Ava: Tiny request: if you're taking home shared plants for the break, please sign the plant board so we know who has them. Thanks!
Noah: Will do. Also taking the peppermint stash home after the contest (just kidding maybe). :wink:
Priya: See y'all at noon. Sending everyone a tiny festive GIF. :santa:
